literacy.sentenceEn: And that's a shame, because there is much to recommend in the idea of scientific literacy as it was originally articulated in 1945, a time when science appeared to be the key to progress and scientists seemingly held the fate of the world in their hands.

literary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

literary.sentenceEn: Plays aiming at literary distinction were written for schools or court, or for the choir boys of St. Paul's and the royal chapel, who, however, gave plays in public as well as at court.
literary.translationZh: 追求文学造诣的戏剧作品当时多为学校、宫廷或圣保罗大教堂与皇家礼拜堂的唱诗班男孩们而作，不过这些唱诗班男孩们不仅在宫廷演出，也会进行公开表演。
literary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

literary.sentenceEn: By the time that Shakespeare was twenty-five, Lyly, Peele, and Greene had made comedies that were at once popular and literary ; Kyd had written a tragedy that crowded the pit; and Marlowe had brought poetry and genius to triumph on the common stage – where they had played no part since the death of Euripides.
literary.translationZh: 到莎士比亚二十五岁时，利里、皮尔和格林已创作出既通俗又具文学性的喜剧；基德写出了一部让剧场正厅座无虚席的悲剧；而马洛则将诗歌与天才带上了大众舞台并大获成功——自欧里庇得斯去世后，诗歌与天才在这个舞台上便已销声匿迹。
literary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

literary.sentenceEn: But the professional companies prospered in their permanent theaters, and university men with literary ambitions were quick to turn to these theaters as offering a means of livelihood.
literary.translationZh: 但专业剧团在其固定剧院中蓬勃发展，而怀有文学抱负的大学才子们迅速转向这些剧院，将其视为谋生手段。
literary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

literature.sentenceEn: They chose this particular behavior for three reasons, according to study co-author Eric Schwitzgebel, a philosopher at the University of California, Riverside: students' attitudes on the topic are variable and unstable, behavior is easily measurable, and ethics literature largely agrees that eating less meat is good because it reduces environmental harm and animal suffering.
literature.translationZh: 该研究的合著者、加州大学河滨分校哲学家埃里克·施维茨格贝尔表示，他们选择这一特定行为有三个原因：学生对这一话题的态度多变且不稳定；行为易于测量；伦理学文献普遍认为少吃肉有益，因为这能减少环境危害和动物痛苦。
literature.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

literature.sentenceEn: It was only after I started to write a weekly column about the medical journals, and began to read scientific papers from beginning to end, that I realised just how bad much of the medical literature frequently was.
literature.translationZh: 直到我开始撰写一个关于医学期刊的每周专栏，并开始从头到尾阅读科学论文时，我才意识到大量医学文献的质量常常有多糟糕。
literature.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

literature.sentenceEn: This is the famed citation index, that is to say the number of times a paper has been quoted elsewhere in the scientific literature , the assumption being that an important paper will be cited more often than one of small account.
literature.translationZh: 这就是著名的引文索引，即一篇论文在其他科学文献中被引用的次数。其假定是，重要的论文比那些无足轻重的论文被引用的频率更高。
literature.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

literature.sentenceEn: Court, school, organizations of amateurs, and the traveling actors were all rivals in supplying a widespread desire for dramatic entertainment; and no boy who went to a grammar school could be ignorant that the drama was a form of literature which gave glory to Greece and Rome and might yet bring honor to England.
literature.translationZh: 宫廷、学校、业余剧团以及巡回演员都竞相满足人们对戏剧娱乐的广泛需求；任何上过文法学校的男孩都不会不知道，戏剧是一种曾为希腊和罗马带来荣耀的文学形式，或许也能为英格兰带来荣誉。
literature.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

literature.sentenceEn: For a time literature showed no interest in this public stage.
literature.translationZh: 有段时间，文学界对这个公共舞台毫无兴趣。
literature.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

literature.sentenceEn: Humans are unique in their capacity to not only make tools but then turn around and use them to create superfluous material goods – paintings, sculpture and architecture – and superfluous experiences – music, literature , religion and philosophy.
literature.translationZh: 人类的独特之处在于，他们不仅能够制造工具，还能转而使用这些工具创造多余的物质产品——如绘画、雕塑和建筑——以及多余的精神体验——如音乐、文学、宗教和哲学。
literature.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

legitimate.sentenceEn: Consulting firm Parks Associates predicts that legitimate US streaming services' cumulative loss from piracy since 2022 will reach $113 billion in the next two years.
legitimate.translationZh: 咨询公司帕克斯协会预测，自2022年以来，美国合法流媒体服务因盗版造成的累计损失在未来两年将达到1130亿美元。
legitimate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

legitimate.sentenceEn: Initially the rise of legitimate online businesses such as Netflix actually helped curb digital piracy, which had largely been based on file uploads.
legitimate.translationZh: 最初，像Netflix这样的合法在线企业的兴起实际上有助于遏制数字盗版，而当时的盗版主要以文件上传为基础。
legitimate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

legitimate.sentenceEn: But the age of streaming has been a boon for some unintended winners: pirates that use software to rip a film or television show in seconds from legitimate online video platforms and host the titles on their own, illegitimate services, which rake in about $2 billion annually from ads and subscriptions.
legitimate.translationZh: 但流媒体时代却意外地成就了一批赢家：盗版者利用软件在几秒钟内从合法在线视频平台上窃取电影或电视节目，然后将这些内容放在自己的非法网站上。这些盗版网站每年通过广告和订阅能赚取约20亿美元。
legitimate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

legitimate.sentenceEn: Today, professors routinely treat the progressive interpretation of history and progressive public policy as the proper subject of study while portraying conservative or classical liberal ideas – such as free markets and self-reliance – as falling outside the boundaries of routine, and sometimes legitimate , intellectual investigation.
legitimate.translationZh: 如今，教授们通常将对历史的进步主义解读和进步主义公共政策视为恰当的研究课题，同时将保守派或古典自由主义思想——如自由市场和自力更生——描绘成超出常规研究范畴，有时甚至是超出正当学术探讨界限的内容。
legitimate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

legitimate.sentenceEn: As Nature has pointed out before, there are some legitimate concerns about how science prizes – both new and old – are distributed.
legitimate.translationZh: 正如《自然》杂志此前指出的那样，对于科学奖项——无论是新设立的还是历史悠久的——的分配方式，存在一些合理的担忧。
legitimate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

legitimate.sentenceEn: In effect, the White House claimed that it could invalidate any otherwise legitimate state law that it disagrees with.
legitimate.translationZh: 实际上，白宫声称其有权宣布任何它不认同的、原本合法的州法律无效。
legitimate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

locate.sentenceEn: The animals could benefit from more research: Currently, there are no published genomes from donkeys located south of the Equator in Africa.
locate.translationZh: 这些动物可能会从更多的研究中受益：目前，赤道以南的非洲驴类尚无已发布的基因组数据。
locate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

locate.sentenceEn: Located in the southern Peloponnesian peninsula, Pavlopetri (the modern name of the site) emerged as a Neolithic settlement around 3500 B.C. and became an important trading center for Mycenaean Greece (1650–1180 B.C.).
locate.translationZh: 帕夫洛佩特里（该遗址的现代名称）位于伯罗奔尼撒半岛南部，约公元前3500年成为新石器时代聚落，并在迈锡尼文明时期（公元前1650-1180年）发展为希腊重要的贸易中心。
locate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

locate.sentenceEn: Free-ranging elephants presumably also use this information to locate their preferred food.
locate.translationZh: 自由活动的大象很可能也利用这些信息来寻找它们偏爱的食物。
locate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

locate.sentenceEn: They were typically located outside the walls of a city or village and were usually funded by local governments or privately.
locate.translationZh: 它们通常位于城市或村庄的城墙之外，资金来源一般为当地政府或私人出资。
locate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

locate.sentenceEn: Companies located in places with happier people invest more, according to a recent research paper.
locate.translationZh: 根据最近的一篇研究论文，位于居民幸福感较强地区的公司会投入更多资金。
locate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

locate.sentenceEn: In one case, many researchers working around the ancient Maya city of Copán, Honduras, have located hundreds of small rural villages and individual dwellings by using aerial photographs and by making surveys on foot.
locate.translationZh: 例如，在洪都拉斯的古玛雅城市科潘附近工作的许多研究人员，通过航空照片和徒步调查，发现了数百个小型农村村庄和独立住宅。

leading.sentenceEn: As science and technology progressed, and divided into more sub-disciplines, the centre was simultaneously looking to a time when leading researchers could also be artists, writers and poets, and vice versa.
leading.translationZh: 随着科学技术的发展并细分为更多子学科，该中心同时展望这样一个时代：顶尖研究人员也可以成为艺术家、作家和诗人，反之亦然。
leading.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

leading.sentenceEn: DeepMind is one of the leading artificial intelligence (AI) companies in the world.
leading.translationZh: 深度思维公司（DeepMind）是全球领先的人工智能（AI）企业之一。
leading.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

leading.sentenceEn: Complex international, economic, technological and cultural changes could start to diminish the leading position of English as the language of the world market, and UK interests which enjoy advantage from the breadth of English usage would consequently face new pressures.
leading.translationZh: 复杂的国际、经济、技术和文化变革可能会开始削弱英语作为世界市场语言的领先地位，而那些因英语使用广泛而获益的英国利益集团将因此面临新的压力。
leading.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

leading.sentenceEn: Unfortunately, despite 2½ years in the making, "The Heart of the Matter" never gets to the heart of the matter: the illiberal nature of liberal education at our leading colleges and universities.
leading.translationZh: 不幸的是，尽管《问题的核心》这份报告历时两年半才完成，却未能触及真正的核心问题：美国顶尖高等院校中人文教育的非人文本质。
leading.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

leading.sentenceEn: The Romantics commemorated the leading painters and authors of their day, stressing the uniqueness of the artist's personal experience rather than public glory.
leading.translationZh: 浪漫主义者们颂扬他们那个时代的杰出画家和作家，强调艺术家个人经历的独特性，而非公众的荣耀。
leading.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

leading.sentenceEn: However, many leading American universities want their undergraduates to have a grounding in the basic canon of ideas that every educated person should possess.
leading.translationZh: 然而，许多美国顶尖大学都希望本科生能在那些每一位受过教育的人都应掌握的基础思想经典方面打下坚实基础。

label.sentenceEn: These eggs, which are making their debut now on shelves for as much as $8 a dozen, are still labeled organic and animal-friendly, but they're also from birds that live on farms using regenerative agriculture—special techniques to cultivate rich soils that can trap greenhouse gases.
label.translationZh: 这些鸡蛋目前首次上架销售，售价高达8美元一打。它们仍被贴上有机和动物友好的标签，但其特别之处在于，这些鸡蛋来自采用再生农业的农场——这种农场运用特殊技术培育肥沃土壤，从而能够捕获温室气体。
label.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

label.sentenceEn: Today we have a(n) tendency to label obesity as a disgrace.
label.translationZh: 如今，我们往往将肥胖视为一种耻辱。
label.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

label.sentenceEn: In the last decade or so, advances in technology have allowed mass-market labels such as Zara, H&M, and Uniqlo to react to trends more quickly and anticipate demand more precisely.
label.translationZh: 在过去十年左右的时间里，技术进步使Zara、H&M和优衣库等大众市场品牌能够更迅速地响应潮流，并更精准地预测需求。
label.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

label.sentenceEn: These labels encourage style-conscious consumers to see clothes as disposable – meant to last only a wash or two, although they don't advertise that – and to renew their wardrobe every few weeks.
label.translationZh: 这些品牌鼓励追求时尚的消费者将服装视为一次性用品——本就只打算穿一两水，尽管它们不会这样宣传——并每隔几周就更新一次衣橱。
label.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

label.sentenceEn: The label on a child's Batman cape cautions that the toy "does not enable user to fly".
label.translationZh: 儿童蝙蝠侠披风的标签上警示道，此玩具“无法让使用者飞行”。
label.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
label.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

label.sentenceEn: Feeling threatened, companies responded by writing ever-longer warning labels , trying to anticipate every possible accident.
label.translationZh: 由于感受到威胁，企业纷纷采取对策，撰写越来越长的警告标签，试图预见每一种可能发生的事故。
label.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
label.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

lasting.sentenceEn: But a new study published in Cognition found that, in at least one real-world situation, a single ethics lesson may have had lasting effects.
lasting.translationZh: 但发表在《认知》期刊上的一项新研究发现，在至少一种现实情境中，单节伦理课可能产生了持久影响。
lasting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

lasting.sentenceEn: A badly run "year of culture" washes in and washes out of a place like the tide, bringing prominence for a spell but leaving no lasting benefits to the community.
lasting.translationZh: 一届组织不当的‘文化年’就像潮水一样在一个地方涌来退去，带来一时的名气，却没有给社区留下任何持久的益处。
lasting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

lasting.sentenceEn: Too often we believe that a new job, bigger house or better car will be the magic silver bullet that will allow us to finally be content, but the reality is these things have very little lasting impact on our happiness levels.
lasting.translationZh: 我们常常认为，一份新工作、一栋更大的房子或一辆更好的车会成为那支神奇的"银弹"，让我们最终获得满足。但现实是，这些东西对我们的幸福水平几乎没有持久的影响。
lasting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

lasting.sentenceEn: He agreed to join because he "found the foresight behind the establishment of the SBoRE to be novel, unique and likely to have a lasting impact. This impact will not only be through the publications in Science itself, but hopefully through a larger group of publishing places that may want to model their approach after Science."
lasting.translationZh: 他同意加入是因为他"发现设立统计审查编辑委员会背后的远见具有创新性、独特性，并且可能产生持久影响。这种影响不仅会体现在《科学》杂志本身的出版物上，还有望通过更多可能希望效仿《科学》做法的出版机构产生更广泛的影响。"
lasting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

lasting.sentenceEn: If she hopes her new-found fortune will yield lasting feelings of fulfillment, she could do worse than read Happy Money by Elizabeth Dunn and Michael Norton.
lasting.translationZh: 如果她希望这笔新获得的财富能带来持久的满足感，那么读一读伊丽莎白·邓恩和迈克尔·诺顿合著的《快乐金钱》会是个不错的选择。
lasting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

lasting.sentenceEn: Though several fast-fashion companies have made efforts to curb their impact on labor and the environment – including H&M, with its green Conscious Collection line – Cline believes lasting change can only be effected by the customer.
lasting.translationZh: 尽管多家快时尚公司已在努力控制其对劳动力和环境的影响——包括H&M推出的环保“Conscious Collection”（环保自觉行动）系列——但克莱恩认为，唯有消费者才能带来持久的改变。
lasting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

laughter.sentenceEn: They are noting that the Victorians suddenly seem to become more human as the hundred-or-so years that separate us fade away through our common experience of laughter .
laughter.translationZh: 人们注意到，当分隔我们的百余年时光通过共同的欢笑体验渐渐消散时，维多利亚时代的人们突然显得更具人情味了。
laughter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

laughter.sentenceEn: We tend to think that friends and family members are our biggest sources of connection, laughter , and warmth.
laughter.translationZh: 我们往往认为朋友和家人是我们获取情感联结、欢声笑语和温暖关怀的最大来源。
laughter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

laughter.sentenceEn: Similarly, the physical act of laughter could improve mood.
laughter.translationZh: 同样地，笑这一身体行为能够改善情绪。
laughter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

laughter.sentenceEn: But because hard laughter is difficult to sustain, a good laugh is unlikely to have measurable benefits the way, say, walking or jogging does.
laughter.translationZh: 但由于开怀大笑难以持久，一场畅快的笑不太可能像散步或慢跑那样产生显著的益处。
laughter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

laughter.sentenceEn: Studies dating back to the 1930s indicate that laughter relaxes muscles, decreasing muscle tone for up to 45 minutes after the laugh dies down.
laughter.translationZh: 早在20世纪30年代的研究就表明，笑能放松肌肉，在笑声停止后，肌肉张力的降低可持续长达45分钟。
laughter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

laughter.sentenceEn: Ancient Greek philosopher Aristotle viewed laughter as "a bodily exercise precious to health."
laughter.translationZh: 古希腊哲学家亚里士多德认为笑是“一种对健康极为珍贵的身体锻炼”。
laughter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

launch.sentenceEn: Since the 2008 launch of the high-speed rail network between Rome and Milan, trains have become the preferred means of travel across Italy for locals and tourists alike.
launch.translationZh: 自2008年罗马至米兰的高铁网络开通以来，火车已成为当地人和游客在意大利境内旅行的首选交通工具。
launch.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

launch.sentenceEn: That is why the Reform think tank is launching a new programme of work entitled "Reimagining health", supported by ten former health ministers.
launch.translationZh: 正因如此，改革智库在十位前卫生部长的支持下，启动了一项名为“重塑健康”的新工作方案。
launch.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

launch.sentenceEn: Recent research from the Organization for the Review of Care and Health Applications found that 350,000 health apps were available on the market, 90,000 of which launched in 2020 alone.
launch.translationZh: 护理与健康应用审查组织的最新研究发现，市场上有35万个健康应用程序，其中仅2020年就推出了9万个。
launch.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

launch.sentenceEn: Ed Home, of the RHS, said: "We launched our sustainability strategy last year and fake grass is just not in line with our ethos and views on plastic. We recommend using real grass because of its environmental benefits, which include supporting wildlife, alleviating flooding and cooling the environment."
launch.translationZh: 英国皇家园艺学会的埃德·霍姆表示：“我们去年启动了可持续发展战略，而人造草坪不符合我们的理念以及对塑料的立场。我们建议使用天然草坪，因为它具有诸多环境益处，包括支持野生动物生存、缓解洪涝灾害以及降低环境温度。”
launch.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

launch.sentenceEn: A century ago Octavia Hill launched the National Trust not to rescue stylish houses but to save "the beauty of natural places for everyone forever."
launch.translationZh: 一个世纪前，奥克塔维亚·希尔发起成立了国民信托组织，其目的并非拯救那些华丽的宅邸，而是为所有人永久保存“自然场所的美丽”。
launch.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

launch.sentenceEn: The Breakthrough Prize in Life Sciences, launched this year, takes an unrepresentative view of what the life sciences include.
launch.translationZh: 今年设立的生命科学突破奖对生命科学的范畴持不具代表性的看法。
launch.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

lean.sentenceEn: The researchers looked at data that included measurements of lean muscle and abdominal fat from more than 4,000 middle- to older-aged men and women and compared that data to reported changes in fluid intelligence over a six-year period.
lean.translationZh: 研究人员查看了4000多名中老年男性和女性的瘦肌肉和腹部脂肪测量数据，并将这些数据与六年间流体智力的变化报告进行了比较。
lean.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

lean.sentenceEn: Meanwhile there are steps you can take to help reduce abdominal fat and maintain lean muscle mass as you age in order to protect both your physical and mental well-being.
lean.translationZh: 与此同时，随着年龄增长，你可以采取一些措施来帮助减少腹部脂肪并维持肌肉量，以保护你的身心健康。
lean.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

lean.sentenceEn: "It surely seems plausible that happy people would be more forward-thinking and creative and lean towards R&D more than the average," said one researcher.
lean.translationZh: 一位研究人员表示：“快乐的人比普通人更具前瞻性和创造力，并且更倾向于研发投入，这似乎是合理的。”
lean.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

lean.sentenceEn: The "mommy wars" of the 1990s are still going on today, prompting arguments about why women still can't have it all and books like Sheryl Sandberg's Lean In, whose title has become a buzzword in its own right.
lean.translationZh: 20世纪90年代的"妈咪战争"至今仍在继续，引发了关于女性为何仍不能兼顾事业与家庭的争论，也催生了谢丽尔·桑德伯格《向前一步》(Lean In)这类书籍，其书名本身已成为一个流行热词。
lean.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

lean.sentenceEn: More difficult, in the moment, is discerning precisely how these lean times are affecting society's character.
lean.translationZh: 而此刻，更难的是准确洞察这些艰难时期正如何影响着社会的特征。
lean.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

lean.sentenceEn: They all seem to look alike (though they come from all over) – lean , pointed, dedicated faces, wearing jeans and sandals, eating their buns and bedding down for the night on the flagstones outside the theatre to buy the 20 seats and 80 standing-room tickets held for the sleepers and sold to them when the box office opens at 10:30 a.m.
lean.translationZh: 他们虽然来自五湖四海，却有着相似的模样——面容清瘦、神情专注，身着牛仔裤和凉鞋，啃着面包，彻夜在剧院外的石板路上席地而卧，只为购买那20张坐票和80张站票。这些票是专门为熬夜排队的人预留的，上午10点30分票房开门时就会卖给他们。
lean.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
lean.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

location.sentenceEn: Even as California lost a huge volume of production to other locations , there was still plenty of film production taking place in Los Angeles before this year.
location.translationZh: 尽管加利福尼亚州流失了大量的影视制作业务到其他地区，但在今年之前，洛杉矶仍有大量的电影拍摄工作正在进行。
location.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

location.sentenceEn: There are around 40 official do-it-yourself biology centres across the globe in locations including Paris, London, Sydney, and Tel Aviv.
location.translationZh: 全球约有40个官方的自助生物学中心，分布在巴黎、伦敦、悉尼和特拉维夫等城市。
location.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

location.sentenceEn: A year later, he returned with a few students to examine the location and map the site.
location.translationZh: 一年后，他带着几名学生回到此地考察，并绘制了该遗址的地图。
location.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

location.sentenceEn: Particularly useful in busy locations or during times of emergency, the doors act as crowd management by reducing the obstacles put in people's way.
location.translationZh: 在繁忙场所或紧急情况下，自动门尤为实用，它们通过减少行人通行障碍来辅助人群疏导。
location.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

location.sentenceEn: Data can be gathered on where the customer can be engaged, such as location , devices used, website interactions, and sites visited, to display marketing messages in appropriate forms, including emails, social media posts, pop-up advertisements, and banners at an appropriate frequency.
location.translationZh: 可以收集有关客户互动渠道的数据，例如位置、使用的设备、网站交互和访问过的站点，以便以适当的形式（包括电子邮件、社交媒体帖子、弹窗广告和横幅）并按适当的频率展示营销信息。
location.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

location.sentenceEn: At issue is the TMT's planned location on Mauna Kea, a dormant volcano worshiped by some Hawaiians as the piko, that connects the Hawaiian Islands to the heavens.
location.translationZh: 争议的焦点在于TMT计划选址于莫纳克亚山——这座休眠火山被部分夏威夷人奉为连接夏威夷群岛与天堂的“piko”（生命之脐）。
location.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

landowner.sentenceEn: Coming at a time of fresh incentives from the UK government for landowners to grow more trees, the trade body says these don't go far enough and fail to promote the benefits of planting them to boost timber supplies.
landowner.translationZh: 尽管英国政府最近出台了鼓励土地所有者多种树的新激励措施，但该行业机构表示，这些措施力度不够，未能充分宣传植树对增加木材供应的益处。
landowner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

landowner.sentenceEn: It also encompasses significant hesitation on behalf of farmers and other landowners to invest in longer-term planting projects.
landowner.translationZh: 这还包括农民和其他土地所有者在投资长期植树项目方面的严重犹豫。
landowner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

landowner.sentenceEn: The fund will also be used to compensate landowners who set aside habitat.
landowner.translationZh: 该基金还将用于补偿那些留出栖息地的土地所有者。
landowner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

landowner.sentenceEn: In particular, they called for forging closer collaborations with western state governments, which are often uneasy with federal action, and with the private landowners who control an estimated 95% of the prairie chicken's habitat.
landowner.translationZh: 具体而言，他们呼吁与西部各州政府以及私人土地所有者建立更紧密的合作关系。西部各州政府对联邦政府的行动往往心存疑虑，而私人土地所有者则控制着约95%的草原榛鸡栖息地。
landowner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

landowner.sentenceEn: Under the plan, for example, the agency said it would not prosecute landowners or businesses that unintentionally kill, harm, or disturb the bird, as long as they had signed a range-wide management plan to restore prairie chicken habitat.
landowner.translationZh: 例如，根据该计划，只要土地所有者或企业已签署一份全范围管理计划以恢复小草原松鸡的栖息地，美国鱼类及野生动物管理局就不会起诉那些非故意杀死、伤害或干扰这种鸟类的土地所有者或企业。
landowner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

latter.sentenceEn: The latter group made no effort to recall the information when quizzed on it later, because they knew they could find it on their computers.
latter.translationZh: 后者在随后接受测试时并未努力回忆这些信息，因为他们知道可以在电脑上找到。
latter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

latter.sentenceEn: The latter step would largely offset the financial burden of annually pre-funding retiree health care, thus addressing a long-standing complaint by the USPS and its unions.
latter.translationZh: 后一项措施将在很大程度上抵消每年预先资助退休人员医疗保健的财务负担，从而解决美国邮政署及其工会长期以来的一项抱怨。
latter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

latter.sentenceEn: This distinction is so much so that where the latter is lacking, as it is for these unlikely gardeners, the former becomes all the more urgent.
latter.translationZh: 这种区别如此显著，以至于当后者（即动物对庇护所的需求）无法得到满足时——正如这些特殊的园艺者（指无家可归者）的情况一样——前者（即人类对安宁圣地的需求）就变得愈发迫切。
latter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

latter.sentenceEn: The latter was seen as a (an) consequence of genetic isolation.
latter.translationZh: 而后者（高发病率）则被认为是基因隔离的结果。
latter.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
latter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

latter.sentenceEn: The latter may commit crimes for lack of adequate parental control.
latter.translationZh: 后者犯罪可能是因为缺乏足够的父母管教。
latter.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）
latter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

latter.sentenceEn: It fell short of the latter 's expectations.
latter.translationZh: 这未能满足后者的期望。

lecture.sentenceEn: In his Oxford lectures , Seamus Heaney argued that a poem draws a picture of reality, a "glimpsed alternative" that sets up a contradiction with your own, in ways little and large.
lecture.translationZh: 西amus·希尼在牛津大学的讲座中指出，诗歌描绘了一种现实图景，即一种“瞥见的替代性可能”。这种可能从细微到宏大等各个层面，都与你当下的现实构成了矛盾。

lecture.sentenceEn: This is not to say that there is no point in getting a degree, but rather stress that a degree is not for everyone, that the switch from classroom to lecture hall is not an inevitable one and that other options are available.
lecture.translationZh: 这并不是说获得学位毫无意义，而是要强调学位并非适合所有人，从中学课堂到大学讲堂的转变并非必然之路，而且还有其他选择可供考虑。
lecture.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

lecture.sentenceEn: Finally, there is perspective, which involves acknowledging that in the grand scheme of life, one lecture really doesn't matter.
lecture.translationZh: 最后是视角调整，这包括认识到在人生的宏大蓝图中，一次演讲真的无关紧要。
lecture.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

lecture.sentenceEn: When he feels down – say, after giving a bad lecture – he grants himself permission to be human.
lecture.translationZh: 当他感到沮丧时——比如说，在讲了一堂糟糕的课后——他会允许自己展现人性的弱点。
lecture.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

lecture.sentenceEn: He analyzes the weak lecture , learning lessons for the future about what works and what doesn't.
lecture.translationZh: 他会分析那次效果欠佳的讲座，从中吸取经验教训，为将来总结哪些方法有效、哪些无效。
lecture.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

lecture.sentenceEn: He reminds himself that not every lecture can be a Nobel winner; some will be less effective than others.
lecture.translationZh: 他提醒自己，并非每一场演讲都能达到诺贝尔奖级别的水准；有些演讲的效果会不如其他场次。
lecture.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

legally.sentenceEn: Having said that, I do feel that whatever artifacts find their way to public museums should, in fact, be sanctioned as having been obtained on loan, legally purchased, or obtained by treaty.
legally.translationZh: 话虽如此，我确实认为，任何进入公共博物馆的文物，事实上都应当是以租借、合法购买或条约获取等正当方式获得的。
legally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

legally.sentenceEn: The success of Sci-Hub, which relies on researchers passing on copies they have themselves legally accessed, shows the legal ecosystem has lost legitimacy among its users and must be transformed so that it works for all participants.
legally.translationZh: Sci-Hub的成功依赖于研究人员分享自己合法获取的论文副本，这表明现行法律生态系统已在用户中失去合法性，必须进行改革以服务于所有参与者。
legally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

legally.sentenceEn: The court's ruling is legally sound in defining a kind of favoritism that is not criminal.
legally.translationZh: 最高法院的裁决在法律层面界定了一种不构成犯罪的偏袒行为，这一界定是合理的。
legally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

legally.sentenceEn: Looking beyond the culture war logic of right or wrong means opening up the middle ground and understanding that managing immigration today requires multiple paths and multiple outcomes, including some that are not easy to accomplish legally in the existing system.
legally.translationZh: 超越移民问题中那种非对即错的文化战争逻辑，意味着我们需要开辟中间地带，并认识到当今的移民管理需要多种途径和多种结果，其中包括一些在现有制度下难以通过合法途径实现的方式。
legally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

legally.sentenceEn: Quotas get action: they "open the way to equality and they break through the glass ceiling," according to Reding, a result seen in France and other countries with legally binding provisions on placing women in top business positions.
legally.translationZh: 雷丁认为，配额能够推动实际行动：它们"为实现平等开辟道路，并打破职场天花板"。这一成果已在法国及其他国家显现，这些国家已立法规定女性在企业高层职位中所占比例。
legally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

legally.sentenceEn: The Lord Chancellor said introduction of the Human Rights Bill, which makes the European Convention on Human Rights legally binding in Britain, laid down that everybody was entitled to privacy and that public figures could go to court to protect themselves and their families.
legally.translationZh: 大法官表示，《人权法案》的出台使《欧洲人权公约》在英国具有法律约束力，该法案规定每个人都享有隐私权，公众人物可以通过诉诸法庭来保护自己和家人。
legally.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
legally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句
